name: Alcon Inc.
sector: Healthcare / Eye care devices & vision care (medical technology)
moat_justification: Global eye-care pure-play leader: #1 in premium intraocular lenses (PanOptix/Vivity/Clareon) and a phacoemulsification equipment installed base (CENTURION, now UNITY) that pulls through high-margin consumables and creates real surgeon training/switching costs, plus recurring Vision Care revenue from daily-disposable lenses and Systane ocular health — all riding aging-population cataract demand. But every category is contested by J&J Vision, Bausch + Lomb, Zeiss and CooperVision, contact lenses carry low patient switching costs, premium IOL uptake depends on elective out-of-pocket spend and procedure volumes, and pipeline risk is proven (the ~$402M PowerVision impairment in Q2 2026).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-24), cover page: securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'Ordinary Shares, nominal value CHF 0.04 per share', trading symbol ALC, listed on the New York Stock Exchange and SIX Swiss Exchange — the NYSE security is the ordinary share itself, not an ADS) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Global eye-care leader, moat 7/10 — but at $63.87 the price capitalizes flawless execution: weighted IRR 9.2%, weighted IV@15 $32.50 vs $63.87, base case only 8.6%, and only the super-bull case clears 15%; clears 15% only below ~$32.50.
moat_for: #1 premium IOL franchise (PanOptix, Vivity, Clareon) with leading presbyopia-correcting IOL share
Phaco ecosystem lock-in: CENTURION/UNITY installed base pulls through consumables; surgeon training raises switching costs
Recurring Vision Care revenue: daily-disposable lenses (Dailies Total1, Precision1/7) and Systane ocular-health repeat purchases
Pure-play scale in R&D and a direct global salesforce, riding aging-population cataract and myopia demand
moat_against: J&J Vision, Bausch + Lomb, Zeiss and CooperVision contest every category; implantables faced competitive pressure in 2026 prints
Contact lenses are contested consumer products with low patient switching costs and online/private-label pressure
Premium IOL penetration depends on elective out-of-pocket spend and cataract procedure volumes, which were soft in 2026
Pipeline/acquisition execution risk is real money: ~$402M non-cash PowerVision impairment in Q2 2026
Tariff and manufacturing-cost headwinds flagged in 2026 reporting
